entries.text: The "AutoJs6" activity-bar view contains a "Devices (Devices)" list and "Device Files (Device Files)" tree for browsing, opening, editing, uploading, downloading, renaming and deleting device files and running scripts (requires AutoJs6 6.8.0+)
Upload multiple local folders from the device-files view, preserving subdirectories and empty directories, merging matching directories and overwriting matching files, with progress and cancellation
The `autojs6fs://` remote filesystem opens device files directly in the editor and saves them back; "Browse Device Files" adds a device directory to the workspace
QR connections: "Server | QR Code" displays this computer's connection code, and AutoJs6 6.8.0+ client mode connects after scanning _[`issue #12`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/12)_

Protocol v2: application-level heartbeats (ping/pong) detect half-open connections; extension-initiated LAN/ADB connections reconnect after unexpected disconnection _[`issue #3`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/3)_ _[`issue #13`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/13)_

Reconnection sessions use exponential backoff after unexpected disconnection, for 5 minutes by default with configurable attempts/window/maximum interval; VSCode restores the last connection after restarting (`autojs6.connection.restoreOnStartup`). Add "Reconnect last device (Reconnect)" and "Stop automatic reconnection (Cancel Reconnect)", with status-bar progress

Disconnection notice `bye`: either side informs the peer of explicit disconnection, preventing reconnection and startup restoration; VSCode sends `bye(shutdown)` on shutdown so AutoJs6 (6.8.0+) can reconnect later

Pairing confirmation offers "Allow and remember / Allow once / Deny" for unknown client-mode devices; QR connections use a one-time token for automatic trust. Add "Manage trusted devices (Manage Trusted Devices)" and `autojs6.server.confirmUnknownDevices`; AutoJs6 6.8.0+ shows "Waiting for VSCode confirmation"
LAN discovery (mDNS): "Client | LAN" automatically lists AutoJs6 6.8.0+ devices with server mode and LAN discovery enabled; disable with `autojs6.discovery.enabled`
Large transfers split reads/writes exceeding 1 MiB into 1 MiB chunks, with cancellable progress (AutoJs6 6.8.0+)

"Pull project changes from device (Pull Project from Device)" compares the device copy to the local project, lists added/modified files, previews per-file diffs and pulls selected changes (AutoJs6 6.8.0+ compares `md5` from `fs.list`; older versions compare contents)
Localization follows the VSCode display language (Simplified Chinese / English), including command titles and setting descriptions (vscode.l10n)
Status-bar device indicator for quickly selecting run, save, logs or disconnect actions
Settings (`autojs6.*`) cover listening ports, HTTP command-service address/port, adb path, connection/handshake/heartbeat timeouts, reconnection, log panels and relative save paths
Connection addresses accept hostnames and custom ports (`host:port`, `[ipv6]:port`) _[`issue #20`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/20)_
"Resynchronize entire project (Resync Project)" forces a complete overwrite of the device project _[`issue #29`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/29)_

Fix activation failures when port 6347/10347 is occupied, such as with multiple VSCode windows, causing all commands to report "not found" _[`issue #14`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/14)_ _[`issue #15`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/15)_

Fix device discovery on Linux / macOS when parsing `adb devices` with Windows line endings; add adb autodetection (`ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, common installation paths) and `autojs6.adb.path` _[`issue #35`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/35)_

Fix the inverted `override` flag during incremental sync and failed device deletion when `deletedFiles` contains backslashes on Windows (requires matching AutoJs6 6.8.0+) _[`issue #29`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/29)_
Fix "Stop current script" and "Save" selecting the wrong editor when focus is in the output panel
Fix exceptions from accessing disposed connections after handshake timeout or disconnection

Handle output panels after device disconnection: retain and mark them disconnected by default, or remove automatically with `autojs6.log.disposeChannelOnDisconnect` _[`issue #30`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/30)_
Remove port forwarding when an ADB connection closes

Fix occasional false "Cannot reconnect ..., stopped retrying" messages after unexpected disconnection (previously stopped after 5 attempts, about 31 s); show failure once at the end of the reconnection window with "Retry" / "Do not restore automatically"
Include workspace-relative paths when saving/running files; AutoJs6 6.8.0+ preserves the directory structure in its working directory _[`issue #37`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/37)_
The HTTP command service listens only on `127.0.0.1` by default (previously `0.0.0.0`), preventing other LAN hosts from invoking local commands
Filter virtual interfaces such as Hyper-V / VirtualBox / Docker / WSL, and prioritize the default-gateway interface _[`issue #12`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/12)_
Reduce QR-code density through a shorter payload and lower error correction, and add a size slider to help AutoJs6 focus when scanning
Skip `ignore` directories such as `node_modules` directly during project traversal and remove full-package byte debug dumps
Separate protocol/device/UI/remote-file/QR modules and add pure Node.js unit tests (`npm test`)
Bundle with esbuild, reducing vsix from 9.6 MB to about 1 MB; replace `pinyin` / `systeminformation` with `tiny-pinyin` and system routing-table discovery
Add port explanations and the `protocol.md` protocol document to README _[`issue #10`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/10)_
Refactor device-side Socket framing: replace text headers with a fixed 8-byte binary header (int32BE length + type)
Parse TCP streams with a cumulative-buffer frame loop for reliable partial and concatenated frames
Validate frame types and maximum lengths to detect protocol desynchronization early and prevent abnormal memory growth
Remove unnecessary string intermediates when sending JSON and binary data
Fix server-mode connection failures caused by incorrect version checks _[`issue #27`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/27)_
New projects can use the `dts-link` script task to create a symlink to [AutoJs6 declarations](http://dts-project.autojs6.com/) automatically _[`issue #8`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/8)_

Fix the Run Project and Save Project editor-menu buttons in VSCode (Ref to [terwer](https://github.com/terwer)) _[`pr #25`](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-VSCode-Extension/pull/25)_ _[`issue #26`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/26)_ _[`issue #24`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/24)_ _[`issue #23`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/23)_
Add VSCode editor-menu icon buttons for basic extension operations
Add VSCode Explorer context-menu items for basic extension operations
Pressing Enter with no checked item selects the item under the cursor
Show available IP addresses in connection-picker titles with broader address support
Show every available network interface with details for server-side LAN connections
New projects derive the project name and package suffix from the directory name, with pinyin conversion
Fix possible Not Found errors while running npm install _[`issue #1`](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-TypeScript-Declarations/issues/1#issuecomment-1758808581)_
Fix files being omitted when creating a project in an existing directory
Run npm install or npm run dts after creating a project to deploy declarations
Fix all commands being ineffective
Fix inability to connect to a valid entered AutoJs6 server address that partially matches history
Check and report required files in AutoJs6 project instances
Detect the file type and append an extension when saving an unnamed file to a device

Fix truncated length data when the length of a message sent by the server requires more than four decimal digits _[`issue #7`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/7)_ _[`issue #9`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/9)_
Execute extension commands with arguments over HTTP _[`issue #6`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/6)_
Display the last connection time for previously connected clients
Fix saving files to devices and running/saving projects _[`issue #5`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/5)_
Add detailed descriptions to the command picker to explain available connection methods
Check versions in both directions between the VSCode extension and AutoJs6, reporting abnormal results
Detect and report repeated connections to the same device using the same method
Request confirmation before clearing device connection history
Fix joining large log messages generated by AutoJs6 _[`issue #4`](http://vscext-project.autojs6.com/issues/4)_
Fix focus moving automatically to the output panel (OUTPUT) when a new device connects
Fix script execution when VSCode focus is in the output panel (OUTPUT)
Fix establishing a connection when VSCode has no device history
Support client (LAN) and server (LAN/ADB) connections (Ref to [Auto.js Pro](http://www.autojs.cc/))
Display real-time logs in the OUTPUT output panel of VSCode (Ref to [710850609](https://github.com/710850609))
